name: Sidebar
description: The largest component in the inventory at 774 lines. Provider, trigger, rail, inset, header, footer, groups, menus, submenus, badges and skeletons. Collapse state persists in a cookie; on mobile it becomes a ui:sheet.
intent: A complete application navigation shell — collapsible, persistent, responsive, and keyboard-reachable.

keyboard: Cmd/Ctrl+B — toggle, bound by the provider
requiredAttributes: isActive plus aria-current on the active route
notes: When collapsed to icons, the tooltip prop is the only accessible name a menu button has. Omitting it makes the collapsed sidebar unusable.
The Cmd+B shortcut is registered globally by the provider. Check it does not collide with your editor surfaces.
Uses its own --sidebar-* token scale, deliberately distinct from the page palette.

usage: Any layout needing a collapsible nav that survives reloads
doNotUse: Simple layouts where a header is enough
When you only need a static panel — this brings a provider, a cookie and a keyboard shortcut
Icon-collapsible menu buttons with no tooltip
Page tokens instead of sidebar tokens

agentRules: SidebarProvider must wrap everything, including SidebarInset.
Always set the tooltip prop on SidebarMenuButton when collapsible="icon".
Mark the active route with isActive.
Use the --sidebar-* tokens, not the page tokens.
Mobile renders as a Sheet — verify both.
